spec.obtain: Vultr dashboard -> Account -> API: enable the Personal Access Token and copy it. Add your egress IP to the token's Access Control allowlist (a single host is /32).
gotchas: The token has an IP ACCESS-CONTROL allowlist; a call from a non-listed IP returns 401 'Unauthorized IP address' (hive #296). Residential IPs are dynamic and may need re-adding.
Stale allowlist entries are often leftover GridPane (Google Cloud) management IPs.
